hazards.location_in_image: Center-right, where the white van is parked near the entrance.

hazards.name: Wide Unprotected Roadway
hazards.description: The four-lane road lacks a median or any pedestrian crossing infrastructure, making mid-block crossing dangerous.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A parked van near the driveway entrance blocks the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers on the road.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, white van parked at the curb.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Parking
hazards.description: Vehicles are parked directly on the pedestrian walkway, forcing pedestrians to navigate around them and creating sightline obstructions.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the paved area in front of the buildings

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The concrete surface is heavily cracked and uneven, creating significant trip hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground and midground paved area

hazards.name: Lack of Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or furniture zone between the active roadway and the pedestrian area, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Edge between the dark asphalt road and the lighter paved sidewalk area

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at potential crossing points to improve pedestrian visibility and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Implement marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to clearly designate pedestrian priority areas.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Introduce vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use environment.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters along the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or mid-block curb extensions to reduce vehicle speeds and improve the safety of the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with a central refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Vegetation
interventions.description: Install street trees in a furniture zone or curb extensions to provide a physical buffer, shade, and improve the aesthetic quality of the street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Adding street trees would provide a vertical element to slow traffic and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a continental-style crosswalk to clearly define pedestrian priority and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to create a vertical buffer between pedestrians and the roadway and to encourage slower driving speeds.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures such as speed cushions or narrower lane markings to reduce vehicle speeds on this wide stretch.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Narrow the wide parking lot entrance to reduce vehicle speeds and the length of the conflict zone for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Adding street trees would provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while helping to calm traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurfacing the cracked sections of the sidewalk to ensure a smooth, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Intersection daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Protected bike lane
interventions.description: Install physical barriers like flex-posts or concrete curbs to separate the bike lane from motor vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and level the paved area to provide a smooth, accessible surface for all users.

interventions.title: Bollard Installation
interventions.description: Install bollards along the curb line to prevent vehicles from encroaching on and parking in the pedestrian walkway.
